Title: AI Career Panel
Description: A panel discussion with industry professionals working in AI and machine learning, sharing insights on career paths, skills needed, and emerging trends.

Title: Summer STEM Open House
Description: A campus showcase for prospective students featuring lab tours, faculty meet-and-greets, and short demonstrations from technology and engineering programs.

Title: Career Fair and Resume Clinic
Description: Students can meet local employers, review resumes with career staff, and practice quick interview introductions.

Title: Robotics Demo Night
Description: An evening of live robotics and automation demos led by faculty and student project teams.

Title: Wellness and Study Skills Workshop
Description: A practical workshop on time management, stress reduction, and building healthy routines for the semester ahead.

Title: Transfer Planning Night
Description: An information session for students considering transfer pathways, dual enrollment planning, and program-to-program progression.

Title: Financial Aid and Scholarship Bootcamp
Description: A hands-on event covering FAFSA updates, scholarship search strategies, and document checklists.

Title: Cybersecurity and Data Privacy Seminar
Description: A guest-led seminar on protecting personal information, spotting phishing attempts, and securing student accounts.

Title: Winter Makers Showcase
Description: A year-end celebration of student projects, prototype builds, and small-group demonstrations across technical programs.
